name: TerritoryDetectorComponentServerFacet_AttemptTerritoryUnlock
summary: The client's territory-unlock attempt: the shared 16-byte head (two u64 BE), a 16-byte raw unlock token, two u64 BE, a u16 BE and a u32 BE. 54-byte body, C2S. One live channel-0 record matches the layout field for field.
purpose: The client asks the server to unlock the territory it currently stands in. The server changes the territory replicated state; the two u64, the u16 and the u32 are carried but their meaning is unnamed.

created_when: the player attempts to claim the territory a detector has made claimable
lifecycle.if_absent: the unlock attempt never reaches the server and the territory stays unclaimed

envelope: Record envelope (owned by javelin/frame.py, not a body field): typed header 00 01 followed by the prefix varint b9 23, i.e. type_dec 2297. A client channel-0 record carries that typed header at offset 24, after the 8-byte frame head and the 16-byte actor id.

fields.name: local_facet_id
fields.note: First u64 of the shared message head, and the sending facet's own local id - identity, not request data. Filled by FUN_1416c1c40(facet) = *[*[facet+8]+8] + [GDE+0x10], the key the facet registers itself under in the Context's facet map (FUN_14167c560) and the key the RMI dispatcher looks up. Measured 0x759beaec651b75fc in the live 0x8f9 body.

fields.name: local_actor_id_word0
fields.note: Second u64 of the shared message head, and the first 8 bytes of the client's own actor id - identity, not request data. Writer FUN_1414dbca0 copies msg+0x10 through a stack local and writes it big-endian (htonl64 FUN_1461668a0); the send builder fills it from FUN_1416be9f0 = [session+0x88]. Measured 0xbf85314bbc4a951a in the live 0x8f9 body and in every committed request head.

fields.name: unlock_token
fields.note: 16 raw bytes copied verbatim by the writer and read verbatim by the reader (no byte swap); the atlas names the run a token (meanings.md row 0x8f9: '16 raw token (+0x38)') but what it identifies is unnamed. Measured 43de2bbb1478eea20365f26914786158 in the live body.

fields.name: field_c
fields.note: u64 BE (object slot +0x48, writer/reader agree); meaning unnamed. Measured 0xa2ee7814bb2bde43. meanings.md row 0x8f9.

fields.name: field_d
fields.note: u64 BE (object slot +0x50, writer/reader agree); meaning unnamed. Measured 0xf29e99bd29238cbd. meanings.md row 0x8f9.

fields.name: field_e
fields.note: u16 BE (object slot +0x24); meaning unnamed. Measured 0x9cfa. meanings.md row 0x8f9.

fields.name: field_f
fields.note: u32 BE (object slot +0x20, the LAST field on the wire although the first in the object); meaning unnamed. Measured 0x00000000. meanings.md row 0x8f9.
